sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.15668 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development appearing for respondent No.1, Mr.P.Harinath Gupta,
learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 3, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent No.4 and Mr.B.Jagan Madhav Rao, learned standing counsel appearing for respondent No.5.
2.

The petitioners approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"To issue any appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly in nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of respondents in encroaching and laying road on land of petitioners i.e., land and house of petitioner No.1 admeasuring Ac.00-0250 gts in Sy.No.861/p; land and house of petitioner No.2 admeasuring Ac.00-0250 gts in Sy.No.861/P, land and house of petitioner No.3 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy,No.861/5/1; land and house of petitioner No.4 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/2, land WP_15668_2023 SN,J and house of petitioner No.5 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/3, land and house of petitioner No.6 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/4, land and house of petitioner No.7 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/5, land and house of petitioner No.8 admeasuring Ac.00-19 gts in Sy.No.870/A, land and house of petitioner No.9 admeasuring Ac.00-0080 gts in Sy.No.868/A, Ac.00-09 gts in Sy.No.868/AA, Ac.00-08 gts in Sy.No.868/E (total admeasuring Ac.00-25 gts);
situated at Medchal Village and Mandal, Medchal- Malkajgiri District abutting 100 feet National Highway (NH44) for the purpose of widening of the existing road from 100 feet to 150 feet without initiating proceedings for acquisition under The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition & Rehabilitation Act,
2013 as illegal, arbitrary and in violation of Art.300A of Constitution of India and consequently direct Respondents to not to encroach and lay road without initiating proceedings for acquisition under The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition & Rehabilitation Act, 2013 in the interest of justice and pass such other order or orders as are deemed fit in circumstance of the case."

opennyai_summary.arguments: It is represented by learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.2 and 3 that the due process under law would be followed in the event, if the petitioners lands are sought to be acquired.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from land and house of petitioner No.1 admeasuring Ac.00-0250 gts in Sy.No.861/P;
land and house of petitioner No.2 admeasuring Ac.00-0250 gts in Sy.No.861/P, land and house of petitioner No.3 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy,No.861/5/1; land and house of petitioner No.4 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/2, land and house of petitioner No.5 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/3, land and house of petitioner No.6 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/4, land and house of petitioner No.7 admeasuring Ac.00-0100 gts in Sy.No.861/5/5,
land and house of petitioner No.8 admeasuring Ac.00-19 gts in Sy.No.870/A, land and house of petitioner No.9 admeasuring Ac.00-0080 gts in Sy.No.868/A, Ac.00-09 gts in Sy.No.868/AA,
Ac.00-08 gts in Sy.No.868/E (total admeasuring Ac.00-25 gts); situated at Medchal Village and Mandal, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, without initiating proceedings for acquisition of land under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and WP_15668_2023 SN,J Rehabilitation Act, 2013.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
